riichi_selection_filter.definition: exclude nondealer first-tenpai hands whose visible-information riichi ron value without ura is exactly 1300 and whose primary wait is kanchan, penchan, or shanpon/tanki without a visible remaining honor wait copy

nondealer_ron_score.definition: each first-tenpai wait is scored as non-dealer ron; each hand first averages its waits by remaining physical-copy count

score_distribution_definition: each scored tenpai hand contributes total weight 1, divided among its winning physical copies by unseen count (four minus concealed and publicly visible copies)

wait_distribution.definition: primary percentage is the share of first-tenpai hands containing each wait; each hand receives exactly one whole-hand structural category, so hand shares sum to one
wait_distribution.percentage_basis: tenpai hands assigned to the wait category

other_by_distinct_wait_tile_types.definition: hands in the primary other category, separated by the exact number of distinct winning tile types

tile_hit_rate_by_wait.definition: probability that the next tile sampled uniformly from the remaining live wall completes a hand in each primary whole-hand wait category

tile_hit_rate_by_tile_type_and_wait.definition: next-live-wall-draw hit probability split by winning tile rank group and wait type; hand_share is the percentage of first-tenpai hands containing at least one winning tile in the cell. One hand may occur in multiple tile-rank cells, but has only one primary wait type

units.expected: conditional expected copies in the named hidden compartment

definition.unseen_copies_U: 4 - visible copies for this observer and tile type
definition.unseen_positions_N: sum(U), equal to live wall + hidden dead wall + opponents' hands
definition.conservation_check: live + hidden dead wall + opponents' hands == unseen for every player/tile

estimation_validation.split_rule: trial_id % 2 == 0 is estimation; odd trial IDs are validation
